scientific_integrity: All-length proof is the explicit XOR-wall evolution, cyclic parity projection, and finite transfer-matrix determinant identity. Finite executable tests through length sixteen are corroboration, not infinite proof. The fixed-point and alternating-cycle classifications are prior knowledge, not claimed novel.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional binary radius-one synchronous majority on indexed periodic rings. The exact-time distribution does not directly extend to fixed boundary conditions, stochastic updates, or larger radii. Historical priority remains qualified because a relevant 1990 chapter could not be examined in full.
title: Exact stabilization-time distribution for the cyclic three-site majority automaton
